attempts.sql: WITH sql_db AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND s.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND s.kind = 'class'), connectors AS (SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN sql_db d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE NOT cf.is_test AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%'), sql_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN sql_db d ON s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = d.symbol_id) WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%'), own_methods AS (SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, s2.name AS method_name FROM connectors c JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols s2 ON s2.file_id = s.file_id AND s2.kind = 'method' AND s2.qualname LIKE s.name || '.%' AND s2.line_start >= s.line_start AND s2.line_end <= s.line_end WHERE s2.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND s2.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM sql_methods)) SELECT DISTINCT class_symbol_id, method_name FROM own_methods ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds SQLDatabase's symbol, then all classes directly subclassing it via class_bases, excluding test files. For each connector class, it selects methods defined within the class's line range whose names don't start with underscore and aren't defined by SQLDatabase itself.
sql: WITH sql_db AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND s.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND s.kind = 'class'), connectors AS (SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN sql_db d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE NOT cf.is_test AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%'), sql_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN sql_db d ON s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE symbol_id = d.symbol_id) WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%'), own_methods AS (SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, s2.name AS method_name FROM connectors c JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols s2 ON s2.file_id = s.file_id AND s2.kind = 'method' AND s2.qualname LIKE s.name || '.%' AND s2.line_start >= s.line_start AND s2.line_end <= s.line_end WHERE s2.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND s2.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM sql_methods)) SELECT DISTINCT class_symbol_id, method_name FROM own_methods ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name
